title: Pixel Star
description:
Pixel Star embodies arcade philosophy; brutally challenging, fun and rewarding. With a focus on progressively intense fast-paced action, player freedom, and solid gameplay, Pixel Star reimagines the shoot-em-up genre. From black holes to space centipedes, nebula storms to stray satellites, there is always something new to discover.Features:
• Loads of power-ups and customization options

• Unique, varied enemy AI

• Merciless boss battles

• Progressive difficulty and intensity

• Open-space environment

• Gorgeous particle effects
description_short: Endless arcade action takes a modern twist, creating a uniquely challenging open space shoot-em-up experience. From brutal bosses to black holes and beyond, countless hazards await discovery. How long can you survive?
